goals.description: Port headless SwarmEngine workflow into src/swarm/engine.ts with subpath exports and backward-compatible shims
goals.verificationCriteria: SwarmEngine is fully self-contained inside src/swarm/ with zero UI/server dependencies; package.json exports ./engine and ./profiler; src/services/swarmEngine.ts acts as clean consumer/re-exporter
goals.evidence: Ported headless SwarmEngine workflow to src/swarm/engine.ts; added root shim src/engine.ts; added package.json subpath exports ./engine and ./profiler; re-exported from src/services/swarmEngine.ts and src/services/providerService.ts; verified headless execution via Step 15 in test-portable-swarm.ts; tsc --noEmit passed (0 errors); vite build succeeded (2.51s).

goals.description: Align ModelRouter and Provider Adapters to guaranteed free-tier endpoints with OpenRouter :free suffix resolution
goals.verificationCriteria: ModelRouter defaults to active free-tier models (gemini-2.5-flash, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, deepseek-r1:free, mistral-small-latest); OpenRouter adapter automatically appends :free when running on free tier
goals.evidence: ModelRouter.getRecommendedModel calibrated to guaranteed free tier endpoints (gemini-2.5-flash with 15 RPM/1M tokens, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, deepseek-r1:free, mistral-small-latest, gpt-4o-mini); OpenRouterAdapter.resolveFreeModel automatically appends :free to prevent 402 errors on zero-balance accounts; verified via Step 4b in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: Implement Autonomous Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) connecting AnalysisLifecycle to MemoryCortex
goals.verificationCriteria: Critic pass/fail and attempt count dynamically compute and reinforce qualityRating in MemoryCortex; critic critique strings persist as exemplar feedback for future prompt distillation
goals.evidence: AnalysisLifecycle upgraded with computeReinforcementScore and LifecycleExecutionResult; critic pass/fail and attempt count dynamically calculate qualityRating (attempt 1 pass = 0.98, attempt 2 pass = 0.88, failure = 0.35); dynamic RLAIF score and critic feedback automatically wire into MemoryCortex.store in SwarmEngine; verified via Step 6 in test-portable-swarm.ts.

goals.description: Optimize Qdrant Cortex with Verified Payload Indexing, Memory Pruning/Consolidation, and Ephemeral In-Memory Vector Fallback
goals.verificationCriteria: ensurePayloadIndex includes verified (bool); MemoryCortex.consolidateMemories prunes memories with qualityRating < 0.4; in-memory fallback enables dense+sparse vector search and exemplar distillation when Qdrant is unreachable
goals.evidence: Added ensurePayloadIndex('verified', 'bool') in MemoryCortex.initialize(); implemented MemoryCortex.consolidateMemories() pruning memories with qualityRating < 0.40 in Qdrant and in-memory fallback; implemented ephemeral in-memory vector fallback enabling dense+sparse hybrid RRF retrieval, semantic deduplication, cross-app shared learning baselines (includeShared), and few-shot exemplar distillation with zero Qdrant dependencies; verified via Step 11f and Step 17 in test-portable-swarm.ts; tsc --noEmit passed (0 errors); vite build succeeded (2.54s).

goals.description: Comprehensive End-to-End Multi-App Verification, Typecheck, Vite Build, and Stress Testing
goals.verificationCriteria: tsc --noEmit passes (0 errors); vite build succeeds; test:portable and test:simulation scripts pass all validation steps and phases under node --experimental-strip-types
goals.evidence: tsc --noEmit passed cleanly (0 errors); vite build succeeded (2.56s, 1681 modules); test-portable-swarm.ts passed all 17 steps covering headless engine, free-tier routing, RLAIF reinforcement, verified index, memory pruning, and ephemeral in-memory vector fallback; test-multi-app-simulation.ts passed all 7 phases validating multi-tenant isolation, 429 failover recovery, 12-task parallel stress test, sub-millisecond payload caching, hierarchical dispatch, and adaptive load balancing.

goals.description: Dual ESM/CJS Distribution Packaging & TypeScript Declaration Emit
goals.verificationCriteria: dist/swarm/ contains ESM (.js), CommonJS (.cjs), and TypeScript declaration (.d.ts) files; test-dist-import.mjs and test-dist-import.cjs pass
goals.evidence: Created vite.config.swarm.ts and scripts/build-swarm.ts; built all modules to dist/swarm/ with full TypeScript type declarations; verified dual ESM and CJS imports via test-dist-import.mjs and test-dist-import.cjs.

goals.verificationCriteria: perfect-swarm bin works with doctor, init, and run commands
goals.evidence: Created bin/cli.js with commands doctor, init, and run; wired package.json bin; tested all commands in test-cli.mjs.

goals.description: Zero-Dependency HTTP & SSE Streaming Server Module
goals.verificationCriteria: Standalone server handles CORS, health, JSON analysis, and SSE event streaming; verified via test-sse-server.mjs
goals.evidence: Implemented src/swarm/server.ts with createSwarmServer, handleSwarmSse, and parseJsonBody; re-exported in src/swarm/index.ts and ./server subpath; wired into root server.ts; tested health, CORS, error handling, JSON analysis, and real HTTP SSE event streaming in test-sse-server.mjs.
